THRS.description: Time History Analysis Results (THRS). Defines a time history result graph entry for a general link (seismic control device), keyed by the time history load case name (THIS_NAME) and the target general link element (GENERAL_LINK); TYPE_RES/COMP select which result quantity and component are graphed.

THIS_NAME.description: Time history load case name that this result graph is based on (resolved to the internal load case key).

TYPE_RES.description: Type of result quantity to graph for the general link. Integer code selecting the result category (e.g. force-deformation, force, deformation, ductility factor, energy).

COMP.description: Component index of the selected result quantity (e.g. the local direction/DOF component of the general link).

GENERAL_LINK.description: General link element number whose time history results are graphed.
